human_approvals.authenticated_identity: bearer token (ewa_ + 32 random bytes), SHA-256 stored, revocable
human_approvals.unit_scoping: other unit -> not_found (404); missing permission -> missing_permission (403)
human_approvals.authorization_location: application services, inside the command transaction, user row FOR SHARE
human_approvals.approval_gate: fresh matched reconciliation snapshot checked after advisory locks on order, rules and invoice-number keys
human_approvals.outbox: invoice.approved / invoice.rejected and a pending delivery in the decision transaction; delivered since stage 09

pdf_guides.visual_check: All pages of both languages rendered at 90 dpi; release and backup sections additionally inspected at full size

repeated_runs.evidence_stage: 09 (historical; not repeated as a separate repeated-run audit in stage 10)

reconciliation.tolerances: absolute, inclusive, per currency (unit price and total)
reconciliation.reproduction: recomputed from the snapshot's own versions
reconciliation.duplicates: same supplier_id and invoice_id in a non-rejected workflow

agent.draft_check: review_draft against stored facts; only lowers to needs_human_review
agent.trace: agent_runs + agent_steps, append-only; codes, sizes, durations, SHA-256; no prompts, document text or explanation
agent.model_field_extractor: ModelFieldExtractor behind FieldExtractor; evidence check unchanged

ui.data_access: HTTP API only; architecture test forbids app, sqlalchemy, psycopg, alembic, pypdf, fastapi imports in ui/
ui.client: standard library urllib, http(s) only, quoted path segments, ApiError without token
ui.idempotency: Idempotency-Key = sha256 of action, workflow, version and relevant inputs
ui.token_storage: page session only; a reload asks again
ui.browser_check: passed in the desktop app's built-in browser on macOS

outbox_delivery.destination: SANDBOX_WEBHOOK_URL, http(s) on 127.0.0.1 or [::1] only; no proxies, no redirects
outbox_delivery.signature: v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp.body) over canonical JSON; receiver window ±300 s
outbox_delivery.semantics: at least once; receiver deduplicates by event ID
outbox_delivery.claim: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, one event per transaction, lock held while sending
outbox_delivery.requeue: operator CLI only, counted in requeues
outbox_delivery.receiver: sandbox/receiver.py, SQLite, no app imports, modes accept/fail/lose_ack/slow

hardening.pdf_worker: RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_AS (Linux), text cap inside the worker, signal death -> resource_limit
hardening.request_body: non-upload POST/PUT/PATCH: Content-Length <= 65536 (413), chunked without length (411)
hardening.agent_quota: 20 runs per workflow per sliding hour, 429 agent_run_limit, read without a lock
